summary: Testamentary suit; Letters of Administration disputed; Will dated 07.07.1982; High Court Division Bench reversed Single Judge's dismissal; Single Judge found Will validly executed but shrouded in suspicious circumstances not rebutted; Division Bench erroneously treated validity findings as conclusively establishing genuineness; appeal allowed; principle that suspicious circumstances must be examined before declaring a Will genuine; registration does not per se prove validity; propounder must remove suspicious circumstances; clarification on distinction between due execution and genuineness; Kavita Kanwar and Derek Lobo cited; impugned judgment set aside; original dismissal of suit restored.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgment of the Division Bench set aside; judgment of the Single Judge dismissing the testamentary suit restored.
